name: Java Snippet Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: |
      contains(github.event.commits[*].added, '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml') ||
      contains(github.event.commits[*].modified, '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml') ||
      contains(github.event.commits[*].added, 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh') ||
      contains(github.event.commits[*].modified, 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh') ||
      contains(github.event.commits[*].added, 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh') ||
      contains(github.event.commits[*].modified, 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Extract Java snippets
        id: extract
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/snippets
          scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh CodenameOne/src > /tmp/snippets/snippets.jsonl

      - name: Validate snippets
        run: |
          set -e
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            echo "Validating snippet from $line"
            if ! scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh "$line" > /dev/null; then
              echo "Validation failed for snippet from $line"
              exit 1
            fi
          done < <(jq -r '.sourceFile' /tmp/snippets/snippets.jsonl)
